quests.reportedSpeech: Priya said that she was tired because she had run ten kilometers that morning.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am tired' becomes 'was tired', and 'ran' (completed earlier) becomes 'had run'; 'this morning' becomes 'that morning'.
quests.nativeTip: Two different backshifts happen in one sentence: the main clause and the earlier reason both move one step back.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Priya said, "I am tired because I ran ten kilometers this morning."" ➔ "Priya said that she was tired because she had run ten kilometers that morning."
